Toddler meals

Quick yogurt rolls

Gyors kifli kelesztés nélkül

10 months+ Adjusted 25 min 8 portions

Keep the crust soft and offer small pieces from ten months. Take them out while they are still pale.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 200 g Plain wheat flour (Ordinary plain flour)
  • 180 g Plain full-fat yogurt (Pasteurized)
  • 2 teaspoons Baking powder (To lift the dough without yeast)
  • 1 tablespoon Mild oil (Rapeseed or sunflower)

Allergens

glutenmilk

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 180°C.
  2. Stir the flour, baking powder, yogurt, and oil into a soft dough.
  3. Shape eight small rolls and set them close together.
  4. Bake until just cooked and still pale, about 12 minutes.
  5. Cool under a cloth so the crust does not turn crisp.
  6. Break into small pieces.

Adjusted

A crisp crust is a choking risk on these rolls as well. Sugar and salt are left out.

Make yogurt and baking-powder rolls with no salt and no sugar. Bake them until soft, not crisp, and serve small pieces.
